name: hongkong-mahjong
description: Production-ready bootstrap for a local and Azure-deployable Hong Kong Mahjong web app.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hongkong-mahjong/game-engine && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @hongkong-mahjong/server" "npm run dev -w @hongkong-mahjong/client"
scripts.dev:lan: npm run build -w @hongkong-mahjong/game-engine && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:lan -w @hongkong-mahjong/server" "npm run dev:lan -w @hongkong-mahjong/client"
scripts.build: tsc -b packages/game-engine apps/server && npm run build -w @hongkong-mahjong/client
